component.name: F1 Spirit
component.summary: Unofficial remake of Konami's F1 Spirit

description.p: F1 Spirit Remake is an unofficial, not-for-profit remake of Konami's F1 SPIRIT: The Way to Formula-1, originally released in 1987 for the MSX home computer systems. Race through Formula 3, Formula 3000 and Formula 1 seasons, upgrading your car between races.
First release of the SDL3 port of the F-1 Spirit remake.

ul.li: Ported to SDL3 and SDL3_mixer, for current Linux distributions
Options menu: music and effects volume, fullscreen, window size, upscaling filter and per-player controls
Gamepad support with hot-plug; gamepads also navigate the menus
Upscaling filters: Scale2x, 2xSaI, hq2x, xBR, OmniScale and Lanczos
Fixes from the original game: saving replays, deleting players, loading car designs and several memory errors
